key_assumption.evidence: The workbook's three restrictor bands are read by position (band 1 = no restrictor, band 2 = 1 restrictor, band 3 = 2 restrictors). Supported by: the D1 note and the labelled example block (D4, D14, D23); ReadMe paragraph 18 (restrictor 0 = highest flow, 2 = lowest); monotonically decreasing band maxima in the blocks with all three bands; magnitudes against the report (~55 cm/s with none, ~35 with two); test cells that reproduce band 3 at the same fan setting (O1, O17, O5a, P16); date labels (workbook DATE cells equal their GMT labels). Caveats: 7/28 band 3 peaks at 22 and 7/29 bands 1 and 3 are identical (possible fouling or copy error); band 3 = 2 restrictors is supported, band 2 = 1 restrictor only reasonably (no converted value depends on it). Converted values are never 'direct'.

rule_fan_to_zero: If the flame survived every finite setting and the test ended by setting the fan or pot to 0 or 'off', limit_type_report = 'none' with the flag FAN_TO_ZERO_END and the last finite stable setting; lo and hi stay empty. P2, P4, P6, P5 and P13a all follow it. A finite 'turned to 0.32' (P13b) is a normal quench. O3a (overshoot to an unknown flow) is 'unclear'.
